subject: System Design
title: REST vs GraphQL vs gRPC
description: Learn REST vs GraphQL vs gRPC in one minute.

hook.text: Three API styles dominate: REST for simplicity, GraphQL for flexibility, gRPC for speed.

buildup.text: REST uses HTTP methods on resources. GraphQL lets clients request exactly the data they need.

discovery.text: gRPC uses Protocol Buffers and HTTP/2 for high-performance service-to-service communication.

twist.text: GraphQL can accidentally expose the entire data model. Without limits, a single query can crash the server.

climax.text: REST for public APIs, GraphQL for client-driven UIs, gRPC for internal microservice calls.

punchline.text: Each API style fits a different communication need.
